column1: # target: Pokémon Legends: Arceus v262144 character recipe table (resident_release.gfpak entry 85, path unresolved)
# note: One row per character id. hash = FNV-1a 64 of the id (= npc_placements.chara_hash). name_src: strings = id string found in Lua
# note: scripts / chara tables / pack names; search = exhaustive candidate hashing; derived = same-group base id + motion-set suffix. Every name is an exact
# note: 64-bit hash match (VERIFIED); none = unresolved (the row is still usable through its hash).
# note: cc = generic character assembled from base + dress + face parts (all in cc.gfpak); tr = one unique pack.
# note: body_type = chara_create_value_list_<code>.trbsm (per-bone mesh scalers; application ASSUMED, not verified).
# note: motion_set = directory of the body .tracn (animation controller); part_motions = face/dress .tracn.
# note: placements = number of npc placement variants using this id (all areas).
# note: controller_clips = clips listed by the body controller resource file (<motion tracn>.tracr), owner prefix kept (VERIFIED strings).
